forensix.title: ForensiX AI
forensix.hook: Multi-modal forensics that explains why an image or document looks tampered.
forensix.description: LLM-augmented forensic system that detects tampered and AI-generated images and documents. A ResNet18 detector is fused with ELA, noise, frequency, EXIF and Grad-CAM signals, and three local specialist LLMs reconcile the evidence into one verdict.

caseStudy.problem: Edited photos, AI-generated images and doctored PDFs or Office files are now easy to make and hard to spot. A single classifier score says nothing about why a file is suspicious, so a reviewer cannot act on it.

results.label: Forensic signals fused with the detector
Local specialist LLMs, no cloud calls

cardioscreen.title: CardioScreen
cardioscreen.hook: ECG screening and population analytics on one shared database.
cardioscreen.description: Multi-label cardiac screening from ECGs plus population analytics on PTB-XL (21,799 records). Macro ROC-AUC 0.910; a confidence gate routes 3.7% of cases to specialist review, and SHAP explains each prediction.

2.title: Info-Nexus
2.hook: GenAI multi-document intelligence with cited answers.
2.description: Upload many documents and query them together. Answers come back with citations to the source passages, alongside live analytics on the document set.

1.title: Smart Exam Evaluator
1.hook: Grades handwritten MCQ answer sheets in seconds.
1.description: Reads scanned, handwritten multiple-choice answer sheets with Gemini OCR and OpenCV, scores them against the key, and exports per-student and consolidated Excel reports.

3.title: CineHome+
3.hook: A local OTT-style cinema you control with hand gestures.
3.description: Turns a personal video library into an OTT-style platform with MediaPipe gesture controls, an AI chat assistant and recommendations powered by Gemini 2.5 Flash.

4.title: The Chai Time POS
4.hook: Point-of-sale for a chai shop, in vanilla JS.
4.description: Order management, real-time billing and sales tracking for small food businesses. Vanilla JavaScript front end with Firebase.

5.title: Wedding Flowers Delivery App
5.hook: Full-stack flower ordering with JWT auth and an admin dashboard.
5.description: Catalogue, customisation, bulk orders with status tracking and PDF bills. React front end on a Spring Boot + MySQL API secured with JWT.

6.title: Job Analytics Dashboard
6.hook: Geospatial and salary analytics over a large job-postings dataset.
6.description: Cleaning, salary parsing and experience extraction in Python/Pandas, with filter-driven geospatial and salary views. Built during the NullClass internship.

churn.title: Customer Churn Prediction
churn.hook: Segment customers, predict churn, serve it over REST.
churn.description: K-Means customer segmentation feeding a Random Forest churn model, exposed through a Flask REST API. Capstone of The Developers Arena internship.

file-forge.title: File-Forge-AI
file-forge.hook: An AI-assisted file workspace on React + Vite.
file-forge.description: A React + Vite front end for working with files, with AI assistance built in. See the repository for the current feature set.

vaibinox.title: VAIBINOX 2026
vaibinox.hook: Event website for the VAIBINOX 2026 symposium.
vaibinox.description: Responsive, component-based event website built with React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.

7.title: Digital Clock
7.hook: A themeable real-time clock with smooth CSS animation.
7.description: Hours, minutes and seconds in real time, with dark and light themes and CSS transitions.
